result.instructions: Tools for keyCRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are still unfulfilled, and who ordered them?"; "Show the products in order 1234 and their current stock levels."; "List the buyers who placed an order in the last 7 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes keyCRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run keycrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run keycrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run keycrm_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. keycrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: keycrm_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders with filters. For unfulfilled orders, first call keycrm_list_order_statuses, then pass the status id here. Use include=buyer,products.offer,status to get the customer and products in one call. One page per call; keyCRM allows 20 requests per minute per key. GET /order.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 15). One page per call.

include.description: Comma-separated related objects to load, e.g. buyer,products.offer,status,manager,payments,shipping.lastHistory. Empty = none.

sort.description: Sort field as keyCRM accepts it, e.g. id.

status_id.description: Filter by order status id (from keycrm_list_order_statuses).

source_id.description: Filter by order source id (from keycrm_list_order_sources).

source_uuid.description: Filter by the order id in the source system.

created_between.description: Date range in UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (start, end).

updated_between.description: Date range in UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (start, end).

shipping_between.description: Date range in UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (start, end).

payment_status.description: Payment status: paid, overpaid, part_paid, not_paid (comma-separated allowed).

has_tracking_code.description: true = orders with a shipping tracking code; false = without.

tools.name: keycrm_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by id, with its products, buyer, status, payments and shipping when included. GET /order/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated related objects to load, e.g. buyer,products.offer,status,payments,shipping.lastHistory,expenses. Empty = none.

tools.name: keycrm_list_order_statuses
tools.title: List order statuses
tools.description: List the active order statuses with their ids and names. Call this first to find the status id for unfulfilled or new orders. GET /order/status.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 15). One page per call.

tools.name: keycrm_list_order_sources
tools.title: List order sources
tools.description: List order sources (sales channels) with their ids. GET /order/source.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 15). One page per call.

tools.name: keycrm_list_order_tags
tools.title: List order tags
tools.description: List order tags with their ids, for keycrm_add_order_tag and keycrm_remove_order_tag. GET /order/tag.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 15). One page per call.

tools.name: keycrm_list_buyers
tools.title: List buyers
tools.description: List buyers (customers) with filters by id, phone, email or date. Use include=company,manager,loyalty for related data. GET /buyer.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 15). One page per call.

include.description: Comma-separated related objects to load, e.g. company,manager,shipping,loyalty,custom_fields. Empty = none.

buyer_id.description: Filter by buyer id or ids.

created_between.description: Date range in UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (start, end).

updated_between.description: Date range in UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (start, end).

tools.name: keycrm_get_buyer
tools.title: Get a buyer
tools.description: Get one buyer (customer) by id. GET /buyer/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated related objects to load, e.g. company,manager,shipping,loyalty,custom_fields. Empty = none.

tools.name: keycrm_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List catalog products with filters by id, category or archive status. Use include=custom_fields for custom fields. GET /products.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 15). One page per call.

include.description: Comma-separated related objects to load, e.g. custom_fields. Empty = none.

product_id.description: Filter by product id or ids.

category_id.description: Filter by category id or ids.

is_archived.description: true = archived products only; false = active only.

tools.name: keycrm_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one catalog product by id. GET /products/{id}.

include.description: Comma-separated related objects to load, e.g. custom_fields. Empty = none.

tools.name: keycrm_list_offers
tools.title: List product variants
tools.description: List product variants (offers) with their ids and SKUs. GET /offers.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 15). One page per call.

tools.name: keycrm_list_stock_levels
tools.title: List stock levels
tools.description: List stock levels per product variant. Set details=true to get the stock per warehouse. GET /offers/stocks.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 15). One page per call.

offers_id.description: Filter by variant id or ids.

offers_sku.description: Filter by variant SKU or SKUs (comma-separated).

details.description: true = stock per warehouse instead of the total.

tools.name: keycrm_list_pipeline_cards
tools.title: List pipeline cards
tools.description: List sales pipeline cards (deals) with filters by pipeline, status, source or date. GET /pipelines/cards.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 15). One page per call.

include.description: Comma-separated related objects to load, e.g. contact.client,products,manager,status,payments,custom_fields. Empty = none.

pipeline_id.description: Filter by pipeline id or ids.

status_id.description: Filter by pipeline status id or ids.

source_id.description: Filter by source id or ids.

created_between.description: Date range in UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (start, end).

updated_between.description: Date range in UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" (start, end).

tools.name: keycrm_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List team users (managers) with their ids, roles and status. Match a user id to the manager of an order from keycrm_list_orders with include=manager. GET /users.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 50 (default 15). One page per call.

user_id.description: Filter by user id or ids.

role_id.description: Filter by role id or ids.

tools.name: keycrm_add_order_tag
tools.title: Add a tag to an order
tools.description: WRITE: add an existing tag to an order. Changes the order in the customer's keyCRM account. Get tag ids from keycrm_list_order_tags. POST /order/{id}/tag/{tag_id}.

annotations.title: Add a tag to an order

tools.name: keycrm_remove_order_tag
tools.title: Remove a tag from an order
tools.description: WRITE: remove a tag from an order in the customer's keyCRM account. The tag itself is kept. DELETE /order/{id}/tag/{tag_id}.

annotations.title: Remove a tag from an order
